JULIAN SARKER, COUNSEL FOR RESPONDENT/PLAINTIFF, SARAH DAVIS, STATES TO THE COURT THAT AN AGREEMENT HAS BEEN REACHED BETWEEN ALL PARTIES, AND IS TRANSLATED TO PEILI ZHAO, APPELLANT/DEFENDANT, BY MANDARIN INTERPERTER MINDY TSOI; THE COURT TRANSCRIPES A WRITTEN RECORD OF THE AGREEMENT (HANDWRITTEN BY JUDGE PRO TEM DAVID COMMINS) AND IS MADE A PART OF THE COURT RECORD AS FOLLOWS: TOTAL SETTLEMENT AMOUNT WILL BE 6,500, WHICH SATISFIES THE ORIGINAL JUDGMENT IN SMALL CLAMS COURT OF $1,117.24. ALL CLAIMS KNOWN AND UNKNOWN ARE WAIVED. CIVIL CODE SEC. 1542 IS WAIVED. THE DISPUTE PRESENTLY BEFORE THE RENT BOARD, WHICH WILL ISSUE AN EVENTUAL DECISION. SUCH DECISION, IF IT IS IN FAVOR OF MS. DAVIS, WILL NOT BE ENFORCED. MS. ZHAO WILL MAKE A SINGLE PAYMENT TO MR. SARKAR'S CLIENT'S TRUST ACCOUNT. MR. SARKAR WILL PREPARE A RELEASE AGREEMENT TODAY, OCTOBER 10, 2018 AND DELIVER IT TO MR. TSOI BY THE END OF THE DAY. THE PARTIES WILL EXCHANGE EXECUTED COUNTERPARTS OF THE SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT BY NO LATER THAN FRIDAY, OCTOBER 12, 2018. WITHIN SEVEN CALENDAR DAYS OF EXCHANGE OF EXECUTED CONUTERPARTS OF THE SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT BUT BY NO LATER THAN OCTOBER 19, 2018 PAYMENT WILL BE DELIVERED TO MR. SARKAR. UPON PAYMENT, A REQUEST TO DISMISS THIS ACTION WILL PROMPTLY BE FILED. THE COURT IS TO RETAIN JURISDICTION PURSUANT TO CCP 664.6 JUDGE PRO TEM: DAVID H.S. COMMINS, CLERK: WILLIAM TRUPEK, NOT REPORTED (525)
